objective.text: Distinguish dispatch uniqueness from overlap prevention during job processing.

difficulty.rationale: Keep payload admission distinct from mutual exclusion while processing.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A job uses WithoutOverlapping middleware but does not implement ShouldBeUnique. A developer expects two matching dispatches to create only one queue payload. What is the correction?

options.text: Only one can enqueue because all queue middleware runs before serialization.
options.rationale: Processing middleware is not the general dispatch admission mechanism.
options.misconception: Processing middleware is not the general dispatch admission mechanism.

options.text: Both enqueue and always execute together because middleware cannot use cache locks.
options.rationale: The middleware can prevent overlap through its processing lock.
options.misconception: The middleware can prevent overlap through its processing lock.

options.text: The second dispatch overwrites the first payload in the queue backend.
options.rationale: The middleware does not implement payload replacement in the queue store.
options.misconception: The middleware does not implement payload replacement in the queue store.

options.text: Both can enqueue; the middleware arbitrates the lock when a worker processes each job.
options.rationale: WithoutOverlapping controls concurrent processing, while ShouldBeUnique applies a distinct dispatch-time lock policy.

explanation.summary: WithoutOverlapping controls concurrent processing, while ShouldBeUnique applies a distinct dispatch-time lock policy.
